decisions.reason: The award-winning hipress high-pressure geothermal probe fits the firm's core plastic pipe competence and a growing geothermal market driven by German heat-transition policy.
The single-U geothermal probe is a standard catalogue item in a growing heat-pump and geothermal segment, so it should stay in the line.
The surface technology for probes differentiates the geothermal range across several models at little extra cost to maintain.
Fire-protection steel profile systems are a certified core business for the firm with long certification lifecycles, which makes dropping them unlikely.
Slim steel profile systems are central to the firm's architectural facade and window offering and remain in demand.
The decorative surface system adds value to the profile range, and as a niche finish it carries only a slightly higher risk of rationalization.
